# Check that you are trusted

Trust is a verdict the indexer computes from public data. This guide shows how to read it, how to read a failure, and how to make the indexer look again after you changed something.

## Resolve

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://idx.testnet.verana.network/v4/verifiable-trust/resolve \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"did":"did:webvh:…","ecsCredentials":true,"services":true,"participations":{"states":["ACTIVE"]},"presentations":{"includeInvalid":true}}' | jq
```

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `trusted` | The verdict: a valid Service credential, and exactly one Organization or Persona credential on you or on the issuer of your Service credential, with every chain intact |
| `evaluatedAtTime`, `expiresAtTime` | When the verdict was computed and when it stops holding (the earliest expiry involved) |
| `ecsCredentials[]` | Your identity credentials with their claims, issuer accreditation and anchored issuance time |
| `participations[]` | Your active accreditations |
| `presentations[]` | Each linked presentation with its credentials; `invalidCredentialIds` and `unresolvableCredentialIds` name what failed |
| `services[]` | The endpoints you declare |

## Read a failure

`trusted: false` always has a reason in the response: an invalid credential id (signature, schema, issuer not accredited at issuance time, expired), an unresolvable one (the presentation URL did not answer), or a missing identity credential. Fix the cause, then re-resolve.

## Make the indexer look again

The indexer re-evaluates on its own when a transaction touches your DID. After you changed your DID Document without a transaction (a new endpoint, a republished credential), ask it: the agent does this itself after each publication when its VS operator authorization or an operator grant covers the message. The frontend has no button for it. The message carries no state; it emits an event the indexer listens to.

## See yourself where others see you

- The frontend's **Agents** page renders your DID as a card with trust state, identity claims and accreditations.
- The [playground](https://playground.testnet.verana.network/personal-wallets) renders a Proof-of-Trust for any DID you paste.
- The [trust graph](./110-graph-and-wallets.mdx) lists you once the indexer trusts you.
